tools.name: search_marketplace
tools.description: Search SuperCatch trading-card and collectibles listings. Returns the top results with title, active-listing count, list-price floor (or labeled market value when unlisted), product slug, and canonical URL.

tools.name: lookup_product
tools.description: Return public SuperCatch product facts (title, effective price, condition, availability, active-listing count) plus the canonical URL for a product or listing slug.

tools.name: lookup_store
tools.description: Return the public SuperCatch seller storefront URL for a username.

tools.name: get_help_resource
tools.description: Return a public SuperCatch help, docs, or agent-access URL.

tools.name: get_api_catalog
tools.description: Return SuperCatch API catalog and OpenAPI discovery links.

tools.name: my_orders
tools.description: List the signed-in user's purchases on SuperCatch, newest first: order id, status, item count, total, and date. Requires connecting a SuperCatch account.

tools.name: my_watchlist
tools.description: List listings on the signed-in user's SuperCatch watchlist with title, price, condition, listing status, any price-alert target, and product URL. Requires connecting a SuperCatch account.

tools.name: store_listings
tools.description: List the signed-in seller's SuperCatch store listings, newest first: status, condition, price, quantity, and product URL. Requires connecting a SuperCatch account that owns an approved store.

tools.name: store_inventory
tools.description: Summarize the signed-in seller's SuperCatch inventory: listing counts by status and total and available quantity. Requires connecting a SuperCatch account that owns an approved store.

tools.name: store_orders
tools.description: List orders placed with the signed-in seller's SuperCatch store, newest first: order number, status, totals, tracking, and dates. Requires connecting a SuperCatch account that owns an approved store.
